scope: Exercise extracted WrapFD buffer geometry, request splitting and completion bounds.
limitations: Actual new/init_io_request/complete/async_io_complete bodies and splitting arithmetic run with host page allocation, DMA map, file, lock and completion shims. Geometry cases simulate full reads and compare every destination byte plus surrounding sentinels. Completion cases model short/error returns in both orders. No real DMA, VFS direct I/O, asynchronous callback race, zero-length ioctl syscall or mmap executed.
